document.title: USG Input Reading v0.3.1 Review Decision Log
reviewed_inputs: Mistral USG Input Reading v0.2 proposal
Claude USG Input Reading v0.2 review/proposal
Claude review of v0.3 (CL2-01 to CL2-08)
ChatGPT/Zara review of Claude's v0.3.1 patch
document.purpose: Record which review suggestions were adopted, modified, rejected or deferred in v0.3 and why. Entries CL2-* are applied in the 0.3.1 draft and await the owner's decision.

decisions.proposal: Treat USG Input Reading as a process contract with addressable project records and an acceptance step.
decisions.reason: Moves the concept from philosophy to a testable, inspectable input process without changing canonical USG stages.

decisions.proposal: Use exact/derived/approximate/observed/ambiguous/unknown as 'the USG protocol evidence model' with no parallel taxonomy.
decisions.reason: Current USG v0.12 canonical evidence uses separate authority and claim-status axes. The six classes remain proposal-level source classes. v0.3 therefore records source_kind + canonical authority + canonical claim_status + provenance.

decisions.proposal: Every interpretation output carries evidence state and provenance.
decisions.reason: Retained, but evidence is represented as multiple independent fields rather than one overloaded class.

decisions.proposal: Tiered prototype equivalence and delta-verification obligations.
decisions.reason: The tier concept is essential. v0.3 prevents a tolerance-based geometry match from becoming 'exact'; it is verified within tolerance and remains approximate/provisional until its delta obligation is satisfied.

decisions.proposal: Mechanically triggered human escalation based on uncertainty and bindingness.
decisions.reason: Makes 'ask instead of guess' operational. v0.3 also includes dependent_count and propagation scope.

decisions.proposal: Record context rather than discard it; map it to record_only downstream.
decisions.reason: Context remains separate and preserved. record_only is described as a proposed downstream disposition because the source-neutral handoff proposal is not yet canonical.

decisions.proposal: Organizational model as descent premise; local contradiction causes local re-entry.
decisions.reason: Prevents a wrong assumption in one region from forcing a complete reread.

decisions.proposal: Starter quantitative complexity metrics.
decisions.reason: Useful for relative ranking, but calibration and weights remain open questions.

decisions.proposal: Reading Acceptance contract with pass/fail checks.
decisions.reason: Acceptance is central to proving the pass. v0.3 adds explicit checks for units, north reference and mirror handedness.

decisions.proposal: Manifest-style project structure with selective loading.
decisions.reason: Directly supports large-model reading and avoids a monolithic JSON.

decisions.proposal: Use RG as the Reading Grid short name.
decisions.reason: The formal concept is 'USG Reading Grid'; individual region identifiers use RG-*. 'Adaptive' describes behavior rather than becoming a second formal name.

decisions.proposal: Position USG Input Reading explicitly as an input adapter in front of USG.
decisions.reason: Preserves the current stage model and clarifies that existing-source reading is evidence intake, not need resolution.

decisions.proposal: Read units, coordinates, north reference and context before repetition analysis.
decisions.reason: These can invalidate every later transform or compass interpretation if wrong.

decisions.proposal: Names, tags and groups are evidence, not truth.
decisions.reason: A recorded source label may be exact as a token while its semantic interpretation remains only observed.

decisions.proposal: Every repetition is tested before compression.
decisions.reason: This is the correct gate between candidate similarity and prototype compression.

decisions.proposal: A mirror is not a copy; re-read handed content.
decisions.reason: Geometric mirror symmetry does not preserve door swings, stair direction, handed equipment, text or asymmetric clearances.

decisions.proposal: A prototype change revalidates every instance delta; instance overrides stay local.
decisions.reason: Prevents hidden propagation errors and matches shared-type lessons already seen downstream.

decisions.proposal: Cross-cell reconciliation is only for geometry without source identity.
decisions.reason: Identity reconstruction is mandatory for geometry without native identity, but source-identified objects still need cross-cell consistency checks.

decisions.proposal: Use dependent_count to decide assumption materiality.
decisions.reason: Dependency count is useful but insufficient alone. v0.3 combines bindingness, dependent_count, propagation scope, evidence state and conflicts.

decisions.proposal: Create synthetic conformance case IR-CC-01.
decisions.reason: A compact deliberately adversarial fixture can test units, context separation, repetition, mirror handedness, identity, nulls and north-reference behavior.

decisions.proposal: Treat exact/derived/approximate/observed/ambiguous/unknown as 'USG's classes, unchanged'.
decisions.reason: The current repository explicitly marks those as proposal source classes, not canonical v0.12 evidence. v0.3 preserves them as source_kind while carrying canonical authority and claim_status separately.

decisions.proposal: geometry_match within tolerance => exact.
decisions.reason: Tolerance proves equivalence only within the declared tolerance. It does not make independent geometry exact.

decisions.proposal: Numeric confidence 0-1 accompanies records.
decisions.reason: Useful for ranking or review, but it must never promote source_kind, authority or claim_status.

decisions.proposal: Worked example should be anonymized.
decisions.reason: The general proposal should not depend on client/project identity; case specifics can remain in separate evidence/example files.

decisions.proposal: Refer to USG as Universal Spec Generator.
decisions.reason: The repository currently defines USG as Universal Structure Generation.

decisions.proposal: No compass meaning without a north reference.
decisions.reason: Prevents invented orientation semantics from entering the project read.

decisions.proposal: Declare source_role (design_intent, existing_conditions, context) per source partition.
decisions.reason: The single source_role model was replaced by orthogonal world_relation / participation_role plus design_authority_relation.

decisions.proposal: Align evidence fields with evidence-class-mapping.md: add 'convention', derive authority from source_kind and source_role, use canonical high/medium/low confidence.
decisions.reason: Authority is no longer derived from a context column or source_kind alone; it is resolved from world relation, actual design authority, provenance and source kind.

decisions.proposal: Remove claim_status from the record; link records to claims instead.
decisions.reason: v0.12 computes claim status per claim from all evidence items; a single reading record cannot carry it.

decisions.proposal: T2 proves placement only; compression needs a content tier.
decisions.reason: An exact array of independent copies proves where they are, not that they are equal.

decisions.proposal: Define 'instance override' for T1; reserve acceptance of unresolved high-materiality items to human authority.
decisions.reason: Both were undefined terms an autonomous reader would fill in itself.

decisions.proposal: Give every reading acceptance check a pass condition and a result value.
decisions.reason: Check names alone cannot prove a pass.

decisions.proposal: Restore the IR-CC-01 construction and expected results.
decisions.reason: A fixture needs expected outputs, not only failure signatures; the wing B construction decides which tier it must pass.

decisions.proposal: Ask about context and existing conditions in the initial questions.
decisions.reason: Context classification is high materiality; the human can answer it in seconds.

decisions.proposal: Use one source_role enum: design_intent | existing_conditions | context.
decisions.reason: Context is orthogonal to design-vs-existing-world. Terrain can be existing-world context; a scan can be existing-world target; an external conceptual model can be proposed-design context.

decisions.proposal: Derive authority mechanically from source_kind + source_role.
decisions.reason: Authority also depends on provenance and whether the current human actually holds design authority. The patch now validates authority from multiple fields rather than assuming every design source is human-authority.

decisions.proposal: Context must not participate in the design read.
decisions.reason: Context must stay outside target design reconstruction/compression, but can legitimately anchor geolocation, north and site relationships and may have its own compact representation.

decisions.proposal: Wing B may be T3 within tolerance except one door delta.
decisions.reason: The previous T3 definition required a whole-geometry match and therefore contradicted the fixture. T3 now permits explicit detected deltas only when residual/base geometry matches within tolerance.

decisions.proposal: Every record has authority/confidence matching authority_mapping.
decisions.reason: convention, ambiguous and unknown records can be non-evidence/open records. Requiring a canonical authority for them contradicted the mapping's own 'none' entries.

decisions.proposal: Remove leftover source_role and stale authority_mapping terminology.
decisions.reason: Stale fields contradicted the orthogonal partition model and would fail curator consistency checks.

decisions.proposal: Make design_authority_relation use four values consistently, including not_applicable.
decisions.reason: Every partition now has a deterministic value; existing_world cannot silently omit the field.

decisions.proposal: Fill authority-resolution gaps for existing-world evidence, unknown design authority, human approximations and derived confidence.
decisions.reason: These are common reading cases and were otherwise under-specified.

decisions.proposal: Prevent T3 from absorbing unlimited difference as deltas.
decisions.reason: T3 now allows only classifiable local deltas and requires a predeclared max_delta_share.

decisions.proposal: Add participation_role=excluded for scratch/history content.
decisions.reason: Keeps source inventory and coverage honest without forcing scratch geometry into target/context reading.

decisions.proposal: Add IR-CC-02 covering consultant design context and existing-world target.
decisions.reason: The new orthogonal source model needs a fixture beyond the simplest human-authored design case.

decisions.proposal: Use target rather than design-only wording in IR-08/RA-04 and exercise existing-world target coverage.
decisions.reason: A renovation scan can be existing_world and still be the primary read target.

decisions.proposal: Re-key authority by world_relation × design_authority_relation (+ provenance); participation_role must not change authority.
decisions.reason: Context/target is a reading-role axis, not an evidence-authority axis.

decisions.proposal: State claim_link timing explicitly.
decisions.reason: Input Reading creates evidence items; USG claims and claim_status exist only when those records are consumed downstream.

decisions.proposal: Map each conformance failure to the RA checks it should trip and add a provisional materiality table.
decisions.reason: Makes IR-13 and the conformance fixtures machine-checkable rather than narrative.

decisions.proposal: Existing-world human statements must use external_evidence rather than human authority.
decisions.reason: This aligns with canonical v0.12: human authority covers project/design decisions, while factual existing-world statements enter as evidence.

decisions.proposal: Define source_origin and add unknown-origin handling.
decisions.reason: Authority rules referenced source_origin without a schema field; unknown origin must not inherit professional authority.

decisions.proposal: Give authority rules fixed order, first-match semantics, and invalid default; fill common gaps.
decisions.reason: Prevents overlapping rules from assigning conflicting authorities and prevents unmatched records from silently choosing authority.

decisions.proposal: Define the measure behind delta_share.
decisions.reason: A percentage is meaningless unless the denominator/measure is declared.

decisions.proposal: Complete materiality table and define override precedence.
decisions.reason: Makes high_examples and conflict propagation operational rather than advisory.

decisions.proposal: Remove duplicate conformance_candidate and merge duplicate claim_link definition.
decisions.reason: Duplicate structures would drift and undermine the curator's single-source checks.

decisions.proposal: Make IR-CC-02 ceiling conflict deterministic with explicit scan value and tolerance.
decisions.reason: A conformance fixture must have one expected outcome rather than depend on reader-chosen tolerance.

deferred_questions: How user_accepted is represented if approved by the owner.
Default geometry-match tolerance by source and object type.
Whether IR-CC-01 becomes a pinned conformance fixture.
Whether the seven source_kind classes (incl. convention) are promoted canonically in a future USG version.
Calibrate the provisional dependent_count materiality threshold.
Decide how user_accepted applies to existing_world evidence if adopted.
